sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — The wrong train
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
You'll never guess what happened to me last Saturday!

At first, everything was fine. I wanted to visit my aunt in Bien Hoa, so I went to the train station early. While I was waiting, I bought a coffee and read a book.

At nine o'clock, I got on the train. I was very happy because there were lots of free seats. Suddenly, I realised the mistake. The train was going to Nha Trang, not Bien Hoa!

Fortunately, a kind man helped me. He told me to get off at the next station and wait for the train back. I decided to wait. Eventually, the right train arrived after two hours.

In the end, I arrived at my aunt's house at two o'clock in the afternoon — five hours late! My aunt asked me, "Where were you? Did you get lost?" We laughed a lot. It was a long day, but it was a good story!

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Mai's weekend story
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: Where did Mai go on Sunday?
She went with her ____.
They enjoyed the film.
What happened while they were walking home?
What did Mai realise?
Where was the phone?
How did they get home?
They got home at ____.

script: You'll never guess what happened on Sunday!
I went to the cinema with my sister. At first, everything was fine.
Yes, we did. But while we were walking home, it started to rain.
Very! And suddenly I realised I didn't have my phone.
What happened next? Did you go back to the cinema?
Yes, we did. Fortunately, a man at the cinema found it under my seat.
That's lucky! What time did you get home?
Eventually, we got a taxi. In the end, we got home at eleven.

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Tell a short story

sentences.text: You'll never guess what happened yesterday!
While I was waiting for the bus, it started to rain.
Suddenly, I realised I didn't have my phone.
Fortunately, I found it in my bag.
In the end, I arrived at work at ten.
